$Comment: A phase transition for any fight in this pack that waits on two things: the boss in the Slot
worn into HealthRange, and the Flag a phase macro sets once its own beat has played. It is the
game's own Encounter_Macro_Transition_TargetInHealthRange with that flag added, so a boss worn
down fast still shows the phase's mechanic before the next phase starts.
Name it in a transition slot (Phase2Transition or Phase3Transition) and forward it the flag
the matching behavior macro sets. Clear that flag in the boss's ResetBehavior so the next try

Slot.Description: Marked target slot holding the boss.

Range.Description: Search range for the slot's boss.

HealthRange.Description: Fires when the boss's health over his maximum falls inside this range and the flag is set.

Flag.Description: The flag a phase macro sets once the boss may move on. The transition waits until it is set.
